t: Free data software that links interactive maps and charts in one view.
steps: Download StatPlanet Desktop from the vendor's site.
Ask IT to approve and install it on a test computer.
Unzip or install the program and open the sample data.
Try filtering a map and watch the chart update.
Import a small CSV file and check that it loads.
Check the vendor pricing page before using it for anything other than education.
Plan one short data lesson of your own.
